caption: Prologue Episode | distant-disturbance
art: The silver-haired man in black silver violet armor watches the town below. Distant faint instrumental music and an indistinct laugh drift from a warm open window. He turns away, then stops. A brief violet resonance from Arin's earlier dream trembles in the reflections in his eyes. He quietly repeats only a nonverbal fragment, comparing rather than casting. No real words or explosion.
